build_dir: work/agent-battle-build-9 (started before the build-10 snapshot; Vincent's only authored Mega, Zeraora, evolved on its first action, so no replay is needed)

attempts.notes: T1 Klefki Prankster Light Screen while Mienshao Protected the Fake Out; T2 Prankster Encore locked Klefki into Light Screen for three turns (its chosen move was Thunder Wave) and Mega Kangaskhan's Double-Edge OHKO'd Mienshao (its chosen move was Close Combat, a KO on Kangaskhan); Gliscor Protected on entry then died to Double-Edge + Moonblast; Xurkitree died to a Double-Edge crit; the AI switched Klefki out for Zeraora into Intimidate, Scarf Typhlosion's Eruption forced Protects and pivots, Mega Zeraora's Plasma Fists KO'd Incineroar, then Booster-Speed Great Tusk under Tailwind Headlong Rushed Zeraora, Typhlosion and Klefki in three consecutive turns.

strategy_checks.check: Klefki Prankster Thunder Wave / Light Screen first
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Light Screen (Light Clay, lasted to T8); chosen move T2 and T5 was Thunder Wave on Kangaskhan, both pre-empted by Encore.

strategy_checks.check: Mienshao attacks and U-turns with Regenerator
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Protect (blocked Fake Out), T2 chosen Close Combat (KO read on Kangaskhan) - it was OHKO'd first; U-turn never came up.

strategy_checks.check: Poison Heal Gliscor Swords Dance mode
strategy_checks.evidence: Toxic Orb activated on entry T3 (Poison Heal); chosen T4 move was High Horsepower on Kangaskhan, not Swords Dance; KO'd before acting.
Chosen T5 move was Thunderbolt on Kangaskhan (KO range); OHKO'd first. Electroweb was never preferred.

strategy_checks.check: Scarf Typhlosion Eruption comes in clean
strategy_checks.evidence: Eruption at full HP T6, T7, T8 (99 on Incineroar resisted, 261 on Whimsicott, 342 on Great Tusk), then at 77% T9; Scarf outsped everything including my Tailwind.
Mega Evolved T7 on its first action (after a hard switch into Intimidate on T6); Plasma Fists KO'd Incineroar T8 (Ion Deluge set).

ai_defects.description: T6 the AI hard-switched Klefki out for Zeraora into Incineroar's Intimidate with nothing gained (Klefki was Encored but healthy; the Mega then entered at -1 Atk).

calibration: Won first try 6-2 after a real fight (two faints, Scarf Eruption and Mega Zeraora both took a Pokemon). Keep offsets 1/1/1/1/1/2.
cooler: The Scarf Eruption is exactly the unforgiving read the plan promises and Klefki's Prankster opening is real. It would be cooler if the AI protected its Encore-locked Klefki by not switching the Mega into Intimidate, and if Gliscor reached for Swords Dance behind a Protect instead of attacking into a Mega Kangaskhan.
legality: No legality problem found in the authored set.
